headline: Wage Protests Cost Bangladesh Garment Sector $428 Million
summary: Protests over wages affected 317 factories in Bangladesh, incurring $428 million in sector losses and shifting $254 million in apparel orders to competing foreign countries.
why: Bangladesh is the world's second-largest exporter of ready-made garments, serving international clothing brands across North America and Europe.

impacts.name: Bangladesh Garment Sector
impacts.why: Factory disruptions resulted in direct revenue losses of $428M and order diversion worth $254M.
